__baseline_prompt__.text: A photographic court-life scene in a Korean palace, centered on a woman during a moment of palace life. She stands at a waist-high wooden preparation table in the sheltered kitchen courtyard, inspecting a pale celadon bowl just before it joins the covered dishes waiting on a broad wooden serving tray. Her left palm supports the bowl from below at mid-chest height, while the pads of her right fingertips rest lightly on its near rim; her forearms remain visibly separate and the bowl sits between them. She has turned the empty interior toward the window light, and her focused gaze follows the thin glaze highlight along its lip. Use the supplied reference for her facial appearance and short dark bob with wispy bangs, keeping her particular soft facial proportions and direct, lucid presence recognizable. Her quiet concentration and slight parting of the lips give the portrait a subtle intimate appeal within the working moment. A muted plum jeogori, ivory collar and deep indigo chima form a simple Korean court-inspired silhouette, with sleeves resting back from the hands. Behind her, a sliding lattice doorway leads toward a shaded inner serving passage; stacked shallow dishes and the waiting tray give the pause a practical reason. The swept stone courtyard and timber posts locate the work inside an inhabited palace service area. Soft morning light reaches her face from the open courtyard and draws a narrow reflection across the smooth bowl, while warm reflected light keeps the hands readable. Frame from the hips upward at her eye level, leaving the bowl, both hands, table edge and serving tray legible together. The face is the first point of attention, the supported bowl the second, and the doorway recedes softly behind her. Natural skin texture, restrained plum and blue color, gently worn wood and fine ceramic reflections make this feel like a carefully observed live-action palace drama still.
